objective: Preregistered H-M (Polymarket midterm control odds through the paper's transformation against Trump trades), with report-only category and Kalshi variants.

parameters.universe: 27 US-listed tickers of the paper Table 1 with SIP daily bars (stock ETFs 10, bonds 7, banks 6, UUP, connected 3); asset dropped if bars cover fewer than 80 percent of sessions
parameters.fill: signal from ΔP(t-1) at 16:00 ET, MOC at the close of t-1, close-to-close return of t
parameters.transformation: EMA span 5 of the daily ΔP, percentile rank within the preceding 60 sessions (current included), linear map to [-1, 1], lag one session
parameters.directions: paper Table A.1 verbatim (stock ETFs, banks, UUP, connected long; bonds short)
parameters.window: first valid signal after the 60-session burn-in through 2026-10-02
parameters.signal: mean of Polymarket House and Senate Republican Yes 4pm-to-4pm changes

sources: data/research/prediction_markets/midterms/ (scripts/build_pm_midterm_data.py; Polymarket Gamma events 32225 and 32224, CLOB /prices-history windows; Kalshi public candlesticks; no key)
data/sip/daily (adjusted closes of the 27 tickers; read-only)
data_v1_h20261004_pm_midterm_clob_sipdai.join: daily probability = last price at or before 16:00 America/New_York on each NYSE session; assets joined on session date

feature_v1_h20261004_dp_ema_rank.definition: ΔP(t) = mean over the House and Senate Republican Yes markets of the 4pm-to-4pm change in percentage points (missing session carries the last price; session excluded if both markets are missing); EMA span 5 (pandas ewm adjust=False); percentile rank within the preceding 60 sessions including the current (average rank for ties); signal = 2*rank - 1 mapped to [-1, 1]; lagged one session; first 60 sessions burn-in

label_v1_h20261004_basket_close_to_close.definition: position(t) times direction times close(t)/close(t-1)-1 per asset on SIP daily adjusted closes, equal-weighted mean over kept assets; costs per unit change in position

validation_v1_h20261004_hm_rules.primary_statistic: net annualized Sharpe (sqrt(252)), Newey-West 5-lag t of the mean daily net return, paper predictive regression (next-session direction-signed basket return on ΔP(t), Newey-West t)
validation_v1_h20261004_hm_rules.permutation: 1000 circular shifts of the signal series, uniform between 20 and N-20 sessions, numpy default_rng seed 20261004; real mean net return compared with the 95th percentile
validation_v1_h20261004_hm_rules.continue_rule: net Sharpe >= 0.5; NW t >= 2.0; mean net return above the 95th percentile of the circular shifts (all three)
validation_v1_h20261004_hm_rules.stop_rule: net Sharpe <= 0 on the backtest window: refuted for the midterm setting; the forward shadow still runs to 2026-11-04
validation_v1_h20261004_hm_rules.inconclusive_rule: between: verdict on 2026-11-05 on backtest plus forward shadow as one sample with the same three rules

cost_v1_h20261004_pm_midterm.primary_bps: 2 per side (10 for DJT and PHUN), stress doubled

placebos: circular shifts of the signal, 1000 times (continue-rule gate 3)
sign flip: directions multiplied by -1, expected to mirror
signal from the unrelated highest-volume non-political Polymarket market with daily prices for at least 80 percent of the window, same transformation, expected to fail
benchmark_v1_h20261004_three_placebos.unconditional_baseline: equal-weight mean of the direction-signed asset returns with a constant position of 1

keep_rule: See contracts.validation.validation_v1_h20261004_hm_rules (continue, stop and inconclusive rules). Frozen before any strategy return conditional on the signal was computed.
